observable: N325 norm-5 local landing-pivotal H4 charged rows

selection_rule.two_point_ready: all G1/G2 x plus/minus have abs(z)>=2 at a separation
selection_rule.cubic_nondegenerate: local-variance-normalized 8-real covariance has positive diagonal and an invertible correlation matrix
selection_rule.candidate_pass: at least two separations are simultaneously two_point_ready and cubic_nondegenerate
selection_rule.tie_break: first candidate in the frozen R1,R2,R3,R4 order
selection_rule.phase_policy: phase closure and phase p-values are not used for selection

claim_boundary: This is a common-counter geometry selector, not production evidence.
The scan changes only the annular landing radius of the same local axis-minus-diagonal H4 insertion.
Failure of every candidate would reject this scanned local insertion family, not charged OPEs in general.
